sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that in the future, the two kingdoms of Yehudah and Yosef will remain, representing two modes of serving G-d through Torah and mitzvos, yet Dovid will rule over them as a single shepherd, unifying them beyond all limitations.

translations.translation: With this will be understood the statement, “And My servant Dovid shall be king over them, and they shall have one shepherd… and they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms.”
For even in the future there will be the two kingdoms of Yehudah and Yosef,
meaning the two modes of service of Torah and mitzvos,
and on the contrary,
then there will be the ultimate perfection of Torah study,
for then their work will be done by others,
and it will be possible to engage in Torah in the manner of “Torah is their craft.”
And the novelty is in this,
that nevertheless, “My servant Dovid shall be king over them,”
a great deed,
that all the services then
(even the study of Torah)
will be in a manner of deed and action,
meaning above all boundaries and limitations.
And this is also the precise wording, “and Dovid My servant” specifically,
that he will be in the aspect of a servant,
a faithful servant,
the ultimate perfection,
the aspect of Yechidah to unify You,
that there is only the matter of the singular without any diversions.
And this is drawn down,
as above,
also in the Torah study of the future,
and as above that then Torah study will be in the manner of “Torah is their craft,” etc.
And until “they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms”
(and two camps),
and as it says before this,
“And bring them close, one to the other, for yourself, into one stick, and they shall become one in your hand.”

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the future revelations depend on our service, and the preparation for the revelation of “My servant Dovid shall be king over them” is achieved through serving G-d for its own sake, as taught by the Rambam.

translations.translation: Now, it was explained above that all the revelations of the future depend on our deeds and service.
And likewise, this matter of “and My servant Dovid shall be king over them” will be understood,
that this is accomplished through the preparation in the service of man in the present time.
And it can be said that this is what the Rambam stated there,
that the beginning of service is not for its own sake, and through not for its own sake one comes to service for the sake of the life of the World to Come,
until ultimately one comes to service for its own sake,
to the service like Avraham our father,
whom the Holy One, blessed be He, called “My beloved.”
From the fact that this matter is ruled as law in the book of the Rambam,
it is understood that this matter is required of every single Jew,
and is sought according to their power,
for there exist the powers in every single Jew to reach this service.
And perhaps it can be said by way of hint,
that this above is a preparation for the revelations of the future,
is hinted at in that the Rambam states this matter in the tenth chapter of the Laws of Repentance,
for it is known
that the matter of repentance is the novelty of the future,
as the statement,
“The Mashiach is destined to bring the righteous back in repentance.”
From this it is understood,
that through this service of “for its own sake” in ultimate perfection
(ten),
one comes to the revelation of the future,
“and My servant Dovid shall be king over them.”

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section concludes with a prayer that the prophecies be fulfilled speedily, that the earth be filled with knowledge of G-d like water covers the sea, and that G-d’s kingship and absolute oneness be revealed through the true and complete redemption.

translations.translation: May it be His will that it be so, speedily in our actual days,
that the prophecy be fulfilled,
“For the earth shall be filled with knowledge of the L-rd as the waters cover the sea,”
meaning not only that they will attain knowledge of their Creator according to human capacity,
and in a manner of a wondrous unity unlike any other unity, etc.,
but moreover,
that they will reach the aspect of “as the waters cover the sea,”
the aspect of a faithful servant who is not a separate entity at all.
And the prophecy will be fulfilled,
“And the kingship shall be the L-rd’s over the entire world,”
and especially over Israel, His close nation,
each of whom is like an only child to the Holy One, blessed be He,
connected with the aspect of the singular above,
“Yechidah to unify You.”
And the continuation of the verse will also be fulfilled,
“And the L-rd shall be King over all the earth; on that day the L-rd shall be One and His Name One,”
as “I am written, so I am called,”
that He will be called
(openly)
by the Essential Name and the Explicit Name and the Unique Name,
and there will be a revelation of the aspect of the simple oneness above,
which is connected with the simplicity of the simple man below,
in the true and complete redemption,
speedily in our actual days,
through our righteous Mashiach.
